Description
Centennial College is Ontario’s first public college with five campuses in Toronto, Canada. Centennial offers high-quality Canadian Education that is hands-on and employment-focused. Programs at Centennial promote experiential learning with laboratory instruction, co-op education, internship placements, and real-life industry projects.
Centennial has an international reputation as one of Canada’s top research colleges, top-tier institutional ratings for academic quality, and outstanding rankings in student satisfaction. Centennial offers over 200 innovative online and hybrid programs, including foundations, post-secondary and post-graduate options. Many Centennial programs include Canadian work experience and provide eligibility for designations from Canadian professional associations.
Seven Specialized Academic Schools:
School of Advancement
The Business School
School of Communications, Media, Arts and Design
School of Community and Health studies
School of Engineering Technology and Applied Science
School of Hospitality, Tourism and Culinary Arts
School of Transportation (Aerospace, Automotive, and Motive Power).
Centennial College is a Designated Canadian Learning Institution (DLI) with an approved COVID-19 readiness plan. This means that Centennial students can travel to Canada with study permit approval and the College's comprehensive pre-arrival support.
